GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.title: Phantom
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.description: Cannot be played manually. After you play a non-Phantom Attack, this card may trigger automatically.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.title: Unique
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.description: Each player may keep only one copy of a card with this name in their permanent deck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.title: Immortal Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.description: A Rank 6 or higher Gu. During this run, only one copy of the same Immortal Gu may exist across all players' permanent decks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.title: Activation
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.description: A Gu card must be used with an Activation card in hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.title: Recovery
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.description: After all activations are spent, the Gu enters recovery and returns to the Gu pile after the listed number of turns.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HE_LIAN.title: Fusion
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HE_LIAN.description: Consumes the specified Gu materials to refine a new Gu. Its rank follows the recipe and it is normally excluded from rewards.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI.title: Blood Qi
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI.description: Adapts to the host: damage and Bleed, Block and Blood Essence, or direct Blood Essence. Higher ranks trigger multiple times.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUE_XIANG.title: Moon Phase
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUE_XIANG.descriptio: Blood Moon advances Crescent → Waxing → Full. Each complete host resolution advances one phase.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI.title: Blood Fetus
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI.description: A compound parasite. Each trigger adapts to the host and gains Fetal Movement; it hatches at 3.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TAI_DONG.title: Fetal Movement
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TAI_DONG.description: Blood Fetus maturity. It hatches at 3; devouring another parasite can inherit 1–2 progress.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_TAI.title: Rupture
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_TAI.description: If an immature parasitized host enters Exhaust, remove the parasite and gain 1 Blood Essence without resolving remaining effects.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_FU_HUA.title: Hatch
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_FU_HUA.description: The final resolution after a parasite completes its last trigger, after which it is removed.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TUN_JI.title: Devour Parasite
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TUN_JI.description: Blood Fetus replaces Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite and inherits 1–2 Fetal Movement.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.title: Shared Pool
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.descriptio: AoE damage, Bleed, or Blood Marks are shared totals divided among living enemies, not copied per enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CAN_YUE.title: Crescent
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CAN_YUE.description: Moon Phase stage 1. Resolve the lower shared damage and Bleed pool, then advance to Waxing.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YING_YUE.title: Waxing
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YING_YUE.description: Moon Phase stage 2. Resolve the middle shared pool and possible Blood Marks, then advance to Full.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_MAN_YUE.title: Full Moon
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_MAN_YUE.description: Final Moon Phase. Resolve the largest shared pool and hatch; rank 6+ refunds Blood Essence and rank 9 also draws.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.title: Overflow
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.description: When a resource gain exceeds its cap, the amount that could not be gained is converted into another benefit as stated by the card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.title: Pursuit
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.description: If the target dies, unresolved remaining hits move to another living enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA1.title: Illumination 1
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA1.description: When you have at least 1 Radiance, automatically spend 1 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA2.title: Illumination 2
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA2.description: When you have at least 2 Radiance, automatically spend 2 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA3.title: Illumination 3
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA3.description: When you have at least 3 Radiance, automatically spend 3 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA4.title: Illumination 4
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA4.description: When you have at least 4 Radiance, automatically spend 4 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA5.title: Illumination 5
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA5.description: When you have at least 5 Radiance, automatically spend 5 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA6.title: Illumination 6
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA6.description: When you have at least 6 Radiance, automatically spend 6 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA7.title: Illumination 7
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA7.description: When you have at least 7 Radiance, automatically spend 7 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA8.title: Illumination 8
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA8.description: When you have at least 8 Radiance, automatically spend 8 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA9.title: Illumination 9
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA9.description: When you have at least 9 Radiance, automatically spend 9 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
